In the community discussion, the suggestion to incorporate outdoor games and a small water feature was proposed by ArthasMenethil. Specifically, ArthasMenethil advocated for adding a water feature to the garden, stating, "A water feature would definitely bring some character to the garden! Plus, it would create that relaxing sound of flowing water, which is always nice to have around." Additionally, he suggested including a small seating area and soft ground cover to ensure safety and comfort for the children, as well as fun toys like swings or a small climbing structure, as pointed out by TirionFordring. 

Regarding the addition of outdoor games, playing games was suggested as an activity for the weekend, as noted under the "Games" category. It is mentioned, "Playing games is suggested as a way to engage participants and add fun elements to the picnic experience." Thus, both elements—outdoor games and a water feature—are proposed as enhancements to the children's play area within the community discussion.
